vision.name: Black Mischievous Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Whenever your opponent draws 1 or more cards during combat, destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck and you may raise a player's anger 1.
POWER: Banish the top card of your opponent's discard pile. Discard a card at random from your opponent's hand. Your opponent's next attack this combat gains "Draw a card."
vision.note: portrait Mastery layout; title read from a crop of the original (filename has typo 'Mishievous'); P number printed (reprint of S10 DR1 / S13 style; wording 'anger 1' instead of 'anger 1 level')
